channel.title: General manufacturing – HxGN Spotlight
channel.description: Hexagon’s platform for original stories from opinion leaders and customers

item.title: Engineering Reality sneak peek: The next wave of manufacturing excellence
item.dc:creator: Heather Tuggle
item.description: Sixth Sense announces third cohort of manufacturing start-ups in Engineering Reality magazine, showcasing innovative approaches to manufacturing.

item.title: Enabling the future of work for manufacturing
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Ales Holeček, VP Office, Microsoft, and Hexagon's Arno Zinke discuss how cloud technologies are enabling the future of work in manufacturing.

item.title: How leading brands optimise processes to deliver consistently high quality
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN TV, we discuss the pivotal role that a cloud-based quality management system (QMS) plays in aligning organisations to make better decisions, take faster action and gain financial benefits from more efficient and autonomous operations.

item.title: Cloud manufacturing: The new disruption
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Open platforms are well established in multiple sectors. But it’s a phenomenon called on now to disrupt the manufacturing industry, as well. HxGN TV explores the potential of the brand-new platform Nexus to empower collaborative workflows, innovate faster and respond to change in real-time.

item.title: Digital transformation’s new era
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN Radio, Xalt Solutions president, Dr. Asif Rana, talks through the differences between a digital transformation and digitalisation and what that looks like partnering with Xalt Solutions.

item.title: Participating in emerging industry trends at HxGN LIVE Global 2022
item.dc:creator: Travis Sachs
item.description: HxGN LIVE Global showcases unforgettable industry solutions and digital innovations in fabulous Las Vegas. Travis Sachs, an attendee of 2022’s conference, recounts his favorite parts of the experience below.

item.title: Solving Problems with Xalt: Implementation is not the goal, it’s a milestone event
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode, we speak with the team at TAG CXO on the idea of problem solving versus selling and the importance of having the right technology leader within the organisation to ensure a successful digital transformation.

item.title: Smart manufacturing is speeding up the automotive industry
item.dc:creator: Brian Tidwell
item.description: Technological leaps don’t stop at simply building robots to accomplish simple assembly; full smart manufacturing solutions offer an opportunity to optimise processes at every stage of EV production from design to assembly line.

item.title: Leader Standard Work
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of Solving Problems with Technology, our hosts discuss best practices for the individual and the organisation regarding Leader Standard Work and how technology can make Leader Standard Work more useful.

item.title: The bedrock foundation for any change implementation
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of Solving Problems with Technology, hear from culture innovators Corbins Electric and how they transformed their organisation's success by changing to a culture and people-first mindset as the starting point of their digital transformation journey.
